note: model_class: online inputs are generated by get_inputs() inside the task file from the global RNG (the evaluator calls it after set_seed; the random consumption order is x -> dy -> scale, while mean/inv_var consume no RNG and are derived deterministically from x in the same convention as the 2012 forward). This file records the fixed shape family of get_inputs as the machine-readable version of the task-statement contract; tolerances and global-domain shape constraints live in task.yaml. A hidden/perf case is a dict of {name + semantic fields}: name is a metadata key, which the consumer strips before calling reference.py::make_inputs(**fields) with the remaining semantic fields to generate the inputs deterministically.

shape_family.out_layout: a single one-dimensional float32 tensor with three segments packed back to back: [0, N*C*H*W) dx | [N*C*H*W, N*C*H*W+C) dgamma | [N*C*H*W+C, N*C*H*W+2*C) dbeta (with N=2, C=16 the total length is 2*16*512*512+32 = 8388640)
